title: Bazi Bushen capsule attenuates cardiac systolic injury via SIRT3/SOD2 pathway in high-fat diet-fed ovariectomized mice.
authors: An, Xiaobin; Xu, Wentao; Zhao, Xinyue; Chen, Haihui; Yang, Jinan; Wu, Yan; Wang, Dongyang; Cheng, Wei; Li, Hongrong; Zeng, Lu; Ma, Jing; Wang, Qin; Wang, Xuqiao; Hou, Yunlong; Ai, Jing
one_liner_zh: 研究中药BZBS通过SIRT3/SOD2通路改善心脏损伤，其中分子对接仅用于预测化合物与转录因子HDAC1/2、BRD4的结合，非核心TF-DNA互作建模，方法浅层且对象非蛋白-DNA体系。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Bazi Bushen capsule (BZBS) is a Chinese herbal compound that is clinically used to treat fatigue and forgetfulness. However, it is still unclear whether and how BZBS affects heart function decline in menopausal women. This study aimed to examine the effect of BZBS on cardiac function in a high-fat diet-fed ovariectomy (HFD-fed OVX) mouse model and elucidate the underlying mechanism of this effect. METHODS: The experimental animals were divided into five groups: sham group, HFD-fed OVX group, and BZBS (0.7, 1.4, 2.8 g/kg) intervention groups. Senescence beta-galactosidase staining and echocardiography were used to evaluate cardiac function. SwissTargetPrediction, KEGG and GO enrichment analyses were used to screen the underlying mechanism of BZBS. The morphological and functional changes in cardiac mitochondria and the underlying molecular mechanism were assessed by transmission electron microscopy, western blotting and biochemical assays. STRING database was used to analysis protein-protein interaction (PPI) network. Molecular docking studies were employed to predict the interactions of specific BZBS compounds with their protein targets. RESULTS: BZBS treatment ameliorated cardiac senescence and cardiac systole injury in HFD-fed OVX mice. GO and KEGG analyses revealed that the 530 targets of the 14 main components of BZBS were enriched mainly in the oxidative stress-associated pathway, which was confirmed by the finding that BZBS treatment prevented abnormal morphological changes and oxidative stress damage to cardiac mitochondria in HFD-fed OVX mice. Furthermore, the STRING database showed that the targets of BZBS were broadly related to the Sirtuins family. And BZBS upregulated the SIRT3 and elevated the activity of SOD2 in the hearts of HFD-fed OVX mice, which was also verified in vitro. Additionally, we revealed that imperatorin and osthole from the BZBS upregulated the expression of SIRT3 by directly docking with the transcription factors HDAC1, HDAC2, and BRD4, which regulate the expression of SIRT3. CONCLUSION: This research shows that the antioxidative effect and cardioprotective role of BZBS on HFD-fed OVX mice involves an increase in the activity of the SIRT3/SOD2 pathway, and the imperatorin and osthole of BZBS may play central roles in this process.
abstract_zh: 背景：八子补肾胶囊（BZBS）是一种中药复方，临床上用于治疗疲劳和健忘。然而，BZBS是否以及如何影响绝经期女性心脏功能下降仍不清楚。本研究旨在探讨BZBS对高脂饮食喂养的卵巢切除（HFD-fed OVX）小鼠模型心脏功能的影响，并阐明其潜在机制。方法：实验动物分为五组：假手术组、HFD-fed OVX组，以及BZBS（0.7、1.4、2.8 g/kg）干预组。采用衰老β-半乳糖苷酶染色和超声心动图评估心脏功能。使用SwissTargetPrediction、KEGG和GO富集分析筛选BZBS的潜在机制。通过透射电子显微镜、蛋白质印迹和生化检测评估心脏线粒体的形态和功能变化及其潜在分子机制。使用STRING数据库分析蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络。采用分子对接研究预测BZBS特定化合物与其蛋白靶点的相互作用。结果：BZBS治疗改善了HFD-fed OVX小鼠的心脏衰老和心脏收缩损伤。GO和KEGG分析显示，BZBS的14种主要成分的530个靶点主要富集在氧化应激相关通路中，这通过BZBS治疗阻止了HFD-fed OVX小鼠心脏线粒体的异常形态变化和氧化应激损伤得到证实。此外，STRING数据库显示BZBS的靶点广泛与Sirtuins家族相关。BZBS上调了HFD-fed OVX小鼠心脏中SIRT3的表达并提高了SOD2的活性，这在体外也得到了验证。另外，我们揭示了BZBS中的欧前胡素（imperatorin）和蛇床子素（osthole）通过直接与转录因子HDAC1、HDAC2和BRD4对接来上调SIRT3的表达，这些转录因子调控SIRT3的表达。结论：本研究表明，BZBS对HFD-fed OVX小鼠的抗氧化作用和心脏保护作用涉及SIRT3/SOD2通路活性的增加，而BZBS中的欧前胡素和蛇床子素可能在此过程中发挥核心作用。
